title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: Excellent Miller soundboard captures a high‑energy show that SMOKES with standout Shakedown, Row Jimmy and All Over Now
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an “awesome” Miller soundboard gem, delivering clear and balanced audio. The concert itself is described as ripping and smoking, highlighted by powerful versions of Shakedown Street, Row Jimmy, Scarlet Fire and a truly f‑ing awesome All Over Now. One reviewer notes the unusual Throwing Stones > Day Job segue, but otherwise no criticisms are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews emphasize a high‑energy performance and excellent soundboard quality; a third low‑rating comment provides no technical criticism but introduces some uncertainty, resulting in a strong yet slightly tempered overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners repeatedly call the sound “awesome” and a “Miller gem,” indicating clear, well‑balanced audio with no reported flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set maintains a relentless, high‑energy flow that keeps the audience engaged from start to finish.
